name: PIXEL
summary: A chiptune machine. Write drums, bass, chords and a lead on a grid, chain the bars into a song, and turn the knob to hear it on eight old sound chips.
author: willbearfruits
status_note: Checked in its simulator only. It has not run on a board yet.
hardware_note: Writing is easiest with the joystick; without one the knob moves the cursor.
